headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 win over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. The Pittsburgh Pirates also secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Braxton Ashcraft pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 9. Brandon Lowe led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Matt Shaw (Chicago Cubs) who was placed on the 10-day injured list due to mid-back tightness, and Nathan Church (St. Louis Cardinals) who was placed on the 10-day injured list with a left shoulder strain. The Atlanta Braves transferred Hurston Waldrep from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow surgery.

The Cincinnati Reds made a notable trade, acquiring RHP Zach McCambley from the Miami Marlins in exchange for RF Rece Hinds. The Tampa Bay Rays also made a trade, sending LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox in exchange for 3B Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers in 3-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-1 win over the Detroit Tigers, with Joey Cantillo earning the win after 5.2 innings of scoreless relief. Dillon Dingler led the Guardians' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a 9th homer on a fly ball to left center field.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cardinals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Braxton Ashcraft pitching 7.0 innings, striking out 9 and allowing 1 earned run. Brandon Lowe led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Nationals 2-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a narrow victory over the Washington Nationals, winning 2-1. David Peterson earned the win for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Marlins 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 9-3 victory. Michael Harris II led the Braves' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Cubs 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, marking a win for the Astros. Christian Vázquez and Pete Crow-Armstrong were notable contributors in the game.

top_news.title: **Reds Shut Down Cardinals in Thrilling Tiebreaker**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 0-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, claiming the win in a closely contested game. Zach McCambley was the winning pitcher for the Reds.

top_news.title: **Cubs' Matt Shaw Lands on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs right fielder Matt Shaw has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to mid-back tightness, with the move retroactive to May 20, 2026.

top_news.title: **Reds Acquire RHP Zach McCambley in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zach McCambley in a trade. McCambley joins the Reds after being dealt from the Miami Marlins.
